statement: For the actual negative basis X1,...,X7 and positive basis Yi=B_+(Xi) under the explicit F23 based isomorphism, every continuous finite-field affine representation has equal images of mathcal K_sign and R_sign on the exact character locus chi(Y4)=chi(Y5)=chi(Y6)=1 and chi(Y1)chi(Y2)chi(Y3)chi(Y7)=1. This includes all characteristics, finite scalar-field extension degrees and larger original coefficient fields. For chi=(r,s,t,1,1,1,(rst)^-1), c=rst!=1 and k1=F_p(c)<k0=F_p(r,s,t), the summed H1 restrictions of the m distinct k1-Frobenius conjugates are injective and the cocycle kernel consists exactly of principal tuples whose parameters sum to zero; the rank is 6m+1 on 7m coordinates.

computational_checks: The symbolic producer records 670 exact identities on the three-parameter integral Laurent locus. The separate verifier imports neither producer nor an algebra package and reconstructs all 11 old-source plus 8 negative seed braid words by generic affine multiplication. Its 781 checks verify basis inverses, the principal quotient after clearing only delta7, the two-dimensional invariant inclusion, every diagonal quotient coordinate, the selected comparison table with original zero-based indices and labels, and the actual character-one seed evaluation matrix diag(1-c,s(c-1)). notes: The exact sequence W->Q->four quotient coordinates is given by explicit inclusion, projection and coefficient-section maps. On W the actual source operators at indices 0,7,8,9 are rI2,tI2,I2,I2. The four quotient characters and boundary source2 value separate all possible minimal invariant subspaces across different Frobenius factors. Every cross-type comparison is proved, including coincidences forcing t=1 or t=c^-1; no general quotient semisimplicity is assumed. The invariant-kernel proof uses the explicit intertwiner p_l composed with (p_j|T)^-1 and F24 individual restriction injection. The trace criterion then excludes proper affine images. Cases c=1, k0=k1 and r=1 are handled by their exact maps. General character loci, full marginal equality and K+=D+ remain unresolved.
